text:
olivia: Heads-up: marketplace launch readiness for PartnerNimbus tomorrow. Need final on press timing, hardware hero, and SI runbook.

jared: Press wants embargo at 10:00 PT. PartnerNimbus wants hero + partner badge live at same time.

meera: Ops note: staging slot booking shows a HW image rollout at 10:00 PT too (from our infra vendor). collision risk.

sam: Can we pre-deploy hero assets hidden behind feature-flag and flip on embargo lift? avoids slot hogging.

meera: yes we have a feature-flag schedule. ops needs S3 path + analytics params to validate preview.

olivia: I'll confirm S3 path. PartnerNimbus marketing asked for UTM values and coupon code.

partner-ci: partner uploaded assets: nimbus-hero-v2 at s3://marketplace/partner-nimbus/hero-v2 (uploaded 08:12 PT).

jared: UTM: utm_source=partnernimbus&utm_medium=marketplace&utm_campaign=nimbus_launch. coupon=NIMBUS15. please add to asset doc.

meera: Ops preview scheduled 09:00 PT on staging-2. Flag flip target 10:00 PT (embargo). We'll run a curl smoke test after flip to SI endpoints.

sam: SI checklist reminder: confirm egress whitelist for partner IPs and token exchange flow. Meera, can ops run the tokened health check?

meera: ops will. snippet for SI: `curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://si.partnernimbus.com/health` — expecting 200 OK and {"status":"ok"}.

olivia: owners: assets=partner-ci, ops=meera, press=jared, partner-liaison=olivia. Agenda for 09:00 preview: visual QA, flag preview, smoke test dry-run, analytics verification.

opsbot: calendar reminder created: preview 09:00 PT (staging-2), embargo flip 10:00 PT.

jared: I'll hold press channel; do not flip before 10:00 PT.

olivia: thanks team. if anything fails move hero flip to 10:30 PT and inform press ASAP.

partner-ci: confirmed coupon and utm added to landing metadata. preview link: https://staging-2.redwood.ai/partner-nimbus/preview

meera: saw preview; mobile crop needs tiny adjustment. pinging partner to push patch before 09:00.

sam: great. final note: after flip wait 5m then purge CDN to avoid stale badge. ops will run analytics event check at +7m.
